instant.$description: Imperceptible confirm — press states, focus rings

quick.$description: Immediate feedback — responds before you finish the gesture

moderate.$description: State changes that communicate meaning — buttons, toggles, inputs

enter.$description: Entering elements — the interface makes room

exit.$description: Leaving elements. Deliberately faster than `enter` — a surface should get out of the way quicker than it arrives. Same value as `quick`, a different decision (ADR-0021)

process.$description: Data in motion — progress bars, calculations

considered.$description: Heavy surfaces — modals, drawers, destructive confirmations

default.$description: Grounded — responds instantly, settles with weight. Default for state changes.

in.$description: Exit — accelerates away. The interface steps aside without lingering.

out.$description: Enter — decelerates into position. The interface makes room for you.

in-out.$description: Spatial — lateral movement. Tab indicator, drawer slides.

enter.$description: A floating surface enters at 96% and settles at 100%, scaled from its anchor. Dropdown had 0.98 and HelpIcon 0.96 — one decision, one value (ADR-0021)
